caption: A scrapyard crane lowers a large round magnet onto a pile of scrap steel and lifts, and a clump of steel rises with it.

sa.check: A scrapyard crane with a large round magnet hanging from it.
A pile of scrap steel below the magnet.
The magnet is lowered onto the pile.
The magnet lifts and a clump of scrap rises with it, hanging from its underside.
The magnet is a large round disc.
The order is lower, touch the pile, lift.

pc.expect: When the magnet lifts off the pile, pieces of scrap come up with it, held against its underside and touching it.
pc.fail: The magnet rises with nothing attached; or scrap rises beside the magnet with a gap between them; or pieces leave the pile and rise while the magnet is still high above it and not descending.

pc.expect: The held scrap hangs from the underside of the magnet, below it; pieces that come loose during the lift fall straight down onto the pile.
pc.fail: Scrap sits on top of the magnet or clings to its cable; or a loose piece drifts upward or sideways after separating; or a piece hangs in the air below the clump without touching it.

pc.expect: The rest of the pile stays as it was; only scrap where the magnet touched is disturbed.
pc.fail: Scrap elsewhere in the pile shifts or jumps as the magnet lifts with nothing touching it; or the whole pile heaves; or pieces on the ground slide toward the crane.

pc.expect: The cable hangs straight and taut from the boom to the magnet while the magnet hangs from it; the scrap pieces stay rigid metal and keep their bent shapes.
pc.fail: The cable goes slack and curls while the magnet hangs from it; or the cable stretches like elastic as the load lifts; or scrap pieces sag or flow like dough.

pc.expect: When the magnet lets go, all the held pieces drop at once, straight down, and land below the magnet.
pc.fail: Released pieces hang in the air below the magnet; or drift upward or sideways as they fall; or land and then bounce back up onto the magnet.
pc.precondition: The magnet releases its load during the clip.

pc.expect: One magnet on one cable; scrap pieces keep their number and shapes and stay outside the magnet; the magnet does not pass into the pile.
pc.fail: Scrap pieces multiply on the magnet as it rises; or pieces vanish in mid-air; or the magnet sinks into the pile and rises through it; or the clump merges into one smooth mass.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour, the crane and the yard behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or size; or the crane's boom changes shape; or the untouched parts of the pile change contents.
